description: A SwiftUI view called InstancesSettings that displays a list of instances with their status, platform, device info, and presence indicators. It interacts with an InstancesStore to fetch, refresh, and manage instance data, and provides UI elements such as headers, rows, icons, and context menus for debugging and display purposes.
